comparison.objective: Fill a moka-pot base to a safe level and screw its upper chamber on snugly, with some versions also inserting the coffee basket.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled pouring, vessel handling, coaxial placement, repeated regrasping, and large-body screw rotation.
comparison.success_condition: Water remains below the valve but not underfilled; required basket is seated; top is aligned and turned to its snug range; spill and unsafe handling limits apply.
comparison.reason: Although both include rotational adjustment and regrasping, this record tests liquid metering and threaded vessel assembly, not set-screw release, damper tuning, lock retention, or impact-energy response.
